design.tuning_metric: out-of-fold Brier over the inner walk-forward blocks
design.calibration: isotonic, fitted on the inner out-of-fold predictions

results.served_rule: best servable learner, or the first of ['lightgbm', 'lightgbm_monotone', 'logistic', 'spline_logistic', 'mlp', 'random_forest'] within 0.1% of its Brier score
